notes: Ibn Abbas is read as the last link because his answer («فقال له ابن عباس: إن علي») is the saying that Sa'id relates; he speaks inside a scene Sa'id watched (rule 11): is he the source, or only a person in it?
the questioner «رجلا» is a person in the scene, not a link
the number 6 and «قال:» are left out
